page.title: Obstructions
page.no_data_desc: The device has not returned a field-of-view obstruction map yet. It appears automatically once the connection recovers.

source.real: Obstruction map measured by the device
source.mock: Currently showing simulated data (not measured by the device). It switches automatically once the device returns a map.

tip.scale: Range 0 to 1: how much the signal is attenuated at the worst point in view.
tip.extremes: 0 = that part of the sky is completely clear; 1 = a physical obstacle completely blocks the signal.
tip.compare: Unlike “fraction obstructed”: this metric looks at how bad a single point is, while the fraction measures how much of the view is blocked.
tip.threshold: Card colour uses the same thresholds as the 3D view: ≤ {{clearMax}} clear · ≤ {{partialMax}} partial · > {{partialMax}} blocked

direction.hint_uniform: Obstruction is evenly distributed across the view; no dominant direction

data_notes.title: Data notes
data_notes.body: This view shows the dish field of view as a 3D hemisphere: the centre is the zenith and the edge is the horizon. The colour scale uses the same classifier as “fraction obstructed” above (normalized obstruction ≤ {{clearMax}} counts as clear, above {{partialMax}} counts as fully blocked), so the red/orange area always matches the percentage.
